dct_title_s: State of Palestine - Subnational Administrative Boundaries
dct_description_sm: State of Palestine administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 2 Territory or Region? - Admin 2: 16 Governorate Dates associated with this dataset: - 24 December 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 19 October 2023: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 28 September 1995: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 28 September 1995: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA occupied Palestinian territory (oPt)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-opt). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
